title: Prevent Out of Application Memory Pauses on Low Resource Machines
description: On 2026-11-27 around 17:35–18:01 macOS ran out of application memory and paused Claude Code (resumed 18:01:21 per kernel memorystatus). Find the root causes and make sure it can never happen again: the repo tools (capacity queue, memory warden/guard) must hold the whole machine safe, including processes outside their grants, and packages must be carved so everything compiles on a low resource machine. Findings so far: the Claude desktop app's diff pane repeatedly runs `git diff -M --numstat` against old-repo/1/⛳wip (277881dca, 315,851 files, 100M insertions; no `main` ref exists), reaching over 2 GB RSS per run; the warden restarts frequently ("its own source changed", "no subject for 10 minutes"), leaving unguarded gaps; the warden only acts on its own grant subjects; darwin footprint reads fail and fall back to RSS.
summary:
Root cause of the 2026-11-27 17:30 out-of-application-memory pause (swap 95 % full, compressor 8.26 GB, swap-out 705 MB/s, warden blind to the ~13 GB outside its grants, 151 warden restarts with gaps) is in 🧾️root-cause.md.

Cures:
- Warden (MEM-GUARD): counts foreign memory, enforces grants and vitest workers, hands over without a gap on source change, cancels git above 1.5 GB, uses a swap-free line, and acts on compressed memory only with live danger signals. The compressed-only regression was fixed the same evening.
- Units (MEM-CARVE): 9 staffage test cases no longer parse the whole catalog (peak 3946 to 1295 MB). The export CLI no longer caches all assets, and the model-catalog audit frees memory per file.
- Admission (MEM-ADMIT): elastic reservations converge to the observed peak plus a margin, and cargo/rustc jobs are derived from memory (1 on 8 GB, 3 on 16 GB).
- CAP-REDS: 4 red capacity tests cured; host-capacity tests are 123/123 green.

Open for the dev: fast-forward refs/heads/⛳wip and refs/remotes/origin/⛳wip (git update-ref) so the desktop diff pane stops diffing 315k files. Hub wasm finals are owned by the wasm split ticket. Details are in 📋️summary.md and the lane reports.
